sub_questions.question: Is there a way to test what the knowledge base will retrieve before plugging it into a live app?

claims.claim: Hit Testing panel on the dataset can be used to test retrieval before using the dataset in a live app.
claims.guide_evidence: the **Hit Testing** / retrieval-test panel on the dataset page lets a builder type a sample query and see exactly which chunks would be retrieved and their similarity scores, without needing to run the full app

claims.claim: You type a sample query and it shows which chunks would be retrieved and their similarity scores, without running the full app.

claims.claim: It is a good way to sanity-check chunking and indexing choices before wiring the dataset into a retrieval node.
